scope: 12 synthetic Korean documents, 24 Korean/English questions; actual configured BYZ models. Not a universal quality guarantee or user tour.

semantic_grouping.quality_corpus_limit: The 12 short quality documents each have one source unit, so they do not independently establish boundary-selection quality.
semantic_grouping.result: passed using v3 and the actual BYZ LLM; four ordered units on cats and SQLite produced exactly [p1,p2] and [p3,p4]

semantic_review.reviewer: primary agent compared every final translation, summary, tags, grouping summary and grouping tags with the fixed Korean source
semantic_review.verdict: All stated amounts, dates, deadlines, prohibitions and eligibility conditions are preserved in translation. Summaries are intentionally selective; detailed facts remain in the translation and original. Tags and grouping metadata describe the source topic without replacing source evidence.
semantic_review.proper_name_note: Some noncritical names use English translation or transliteration variants (Sea/Maritime Museum, Jungang/Central Station). The original Korean names and exact anchors remain available; this sample showed no source-identity or factual confusion.
prior_failures_resolved: clinic topic no longer becomes tree medicine
refund grouping summary no longer invents a purchase-order document

compatibility: Captured v1/v2/v3 prompts remain supported with their own descriptor/fingerprint and original instructions. New registrations default to v3.
